newsitem.title: USA: Texas Meridian to boost capital spending.
newsitem.headline: Texas Meridian to boost capital spending.

text.p: Texas Meridian Resources Corp said Tuesday it planned to increase its capital expenditure budget by about $10 million to more than $50 million in 1997 as it acquires more three-dimensional seismic information about drilling prospects in southern Louisiana.

The company said it had signed an agreement with Schlumberger Technology Corp to get more information about the region from Schlumberger's Transition 2000 3D Seismic Development Program. It said it will get seismic data on sites within a recently created 1,500 square mile area of mutual interest between Louisiana Land & Exploration Co and itself.
A spokesman for the company was not available to say how much the agreement was worth.
The company said it expected to have more than 1,300 square miles of seismic data within the next 12 months -- more than four times what it has now.
"The program will enhance the company's competitive position in acquiring acreage and developing its prospect ideas," it said.
Texas Meridian Resources is an oil and natural gas company that explores and develops oil and natural gas properties.
